stations.title: Your takings
stations.gap: A vessel can have no fare

captions: The takings sheet. Bridie wants the cost of Struan's day, on any boats.
Today a vessel can be made with no fare at all, and it goes down as free.
You write a vessel that is never made alone, two kinds with fares, and the day's cost.
Now every trip is some kind of vessel, and each one gives its own fare.
abstract classes, abstract methods and one list for every kind. Next: interfaces.
